infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Horizon requires camera access to capture ground-truth field evidence photos for environmental verification.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Horizon requires your GPS location to verify geospatial accuracy of field observations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Horizon requires access to your photo library to select ground-truth field evidence photos for environmental verification.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Horizon requires permission to save captured field evidence photos to your photo library.
